why: The LH-OSATS is a named, procedure-specific assessment instrument and belongs with the existing OSATS product rather than constituting a general instructional element.
name: Objective Structured Assessment of Technical Skill (OSATS) and Global Operative Assessment of Laparoscopic Skills (GOALS)
product_description: A set of structured observational tools for assessing technical performance in operative and laparoscopic procedures, developed for surgical education and skills evaluation.
